name: planner_agent
description: Planner agent that analyzes neuroscience queries and returns a structured ExecutionPlan JSON (assigns tasks to executor, researcher, and validator).

skills.name: Execution Planning
skills.description: Generate an ordered ExecutionPlan (query_summary + tasks) for brain network analysis using MCP tools.

schema.description: ExecutionPlan schema: {query_summary: string, tasks: [{agent, description, order, input_payload|null}] }

examples.input: Analyze uploaded FC matrix for hub detection and recommend executor parameters.
